parameters.content:
SETUP REQUIRED BEFORE RUNNING
1) Mount a shared folder into the n8n container at /files and place input.xlsx there.
2) Mount your Python scripts folder at /opt/pipeline. generate_random_data.py must print a JSON array to stdout. identify_patterns.py should read the cleaned dataset from your shared storage or be adapted to accept your chosen input/output contract.
3) Configure the Oracle credential and replace YOUR_SCHEMA.YOUR_TABLE. Oracle host in the diagram: orb.local:1521 (verify service name/network).
4) Ensure Ollama is running on the Mac host at port 11434 and has qwen3:14b pulled. For containers, host.docker.internal should resolve.
5) The Metabase node is only a placeholder API call; configure authentication, database ID, and a real SQL query before enabling.
6) The diagram mentions Qwen3-VL:8b, scikit-learn IsolationForest, Oracle OML4SQL, Wren AI, Slack alerts, and PNG charts. Those are not fully wired here because their schemas, credentials, SQL, and output destinations are project-specific. Add/configure them after validating the base flow.
